stories.headline: EA restores 25 classic PC games for Steam and GOG, including Road Rash and Wing Commander
stories.summary: [Electronic Arts](https://www.ea.com/news/ea-classics-launch) has brought 25 legacy titles to Steam, GOG and the EA app. Seven anniversary editions receive modern-PC improvements, including [Road Rash: 30th Anniversary Edition](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448570/) and [Wing Commander: 35th Anniversary Edition](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1996640/). Special launch pricing runs November 5–19; individual prices vary by store and region.

stories.headline: GOG reveals Galaxy for Linux and a new Social platform for 2027
stories.summary: During its November 5 anniversary showcase, [GOG](https://www.gog.com/en/anniversary) outlined a faster, customizable Galaxy client planned for Linux in 2027, alongside GOG Social, a community service with discussion and game-sharing features. GOG also opened closed-beta signups for Social and reaffirmed that the launcher will remain optional for DRM-free downloads.

stories.headline: Hogwarts Legacy receives DLSS 5 neural rendering on PC
stories.summary: [NVIDIA](https://www.nvidia.com/en-eu/geforce/news/hogwarts-legacy-war-thunder-dlss-5-3d-guided-neural-rendering/) says the November 5 update adds DLSS 5's 3D-guided neural rendering to improve in-game lighting and material appearance on supported GeForce RTX 50-series systems. The technology is aimed at visual fidelity rather than just resolution scaling. [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/990080/).

stories.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 starts Season 1 with new DMZ and multiplayer content
stories.summary: [Activision](https://www.callofduty.com/au/en/blog/2026/10/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-warzone-season-1-announcement) confirms the November 6 season includes fresh multiplayer maps and modes, a new X01 Black Site area for DMZ, weapons and events. The Warzone integration also introduces Hajin and Zodiac maps. The update went live at 06:00. [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/).

stories.headline: Experimental Intel XeSS project enables XMX upscaling and frame generation on Proton
stories.summary: A community-developed experimental build now enables Intel's XMX-accelerated XeSS super resolution and frame generation for some SteamOS and Linux games running through Proton. [PC Gamer](https://www.pcgamer.com/hardware/handheld-gaming-pcs/experimental-project-beats-intel-in-bringing-real-intel-xess-super-resolution-to-steamos-and-proton-games-on-linux/) reports early tests on an Intel-based handheld and Arc B580, but the work is unofficial, early-stage and not yet broadly validated.

stories.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever launches with new zones, quests and gamepad support
stories.summary: [Blizzard](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24315820/world-of-warcraft-forever-now-live) confirms World of Warcraft: Forever is live. The permanent companion to modern and Classic WoW launched globally on November 5 at 00:00 and is included with a WoW subscription or Game Time. It adds new and reimagined zones, more than 1,000 quests, nine new five-player dungeons, the Skyborne race and native gamepad support. Three raids unlock on December 9.

stories.headline: Unity reportedly in buyout talks with Silver Lake and Saudi Arabia's PIF
stories.summary: [PC Gamer](https://www.pcgamer.com/gaming-industry/saudi-arabia-owns-ea-and-according-to-a-reuters-report-unity-is-next/), citing a November 5 Reuters report, says Unity Software has held talks with a potential buyer consortium including Silver Lake and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. A valuation around $25 billion was discussed. No acquisition has been agreed, and any deal or its terms could change. The reported talks matter for studios relying on the Unity game engine.

stories.headline: Path of Exile 2 confirms four Nightfowl Twitch Drops for ExileCon 2026
stories.summary: [Grinding Gear Games](https://steamcommunity.com/app/2694490/allnews/) has detailed ExileCon's free Twitch Drops for Path of Exile 2 and the original Path of Exile. Watch the [official stream](https://www.twitch.tv/pathofexile) or an eligible ExileCon channel from November 6 at 21:30 until November 8 at 08:59. Cumulative watch time unlocks Nightfowl cosmetic effects at 2, 4, 6 and 8 hours. Link your Path of Exile and Twitch accounts and claim each reward in your Twitch Inventory before the campaign ends. The showcase keynote begins November 6 at 22:00.
